claim: K2 replaces K1 for repeated context-17 Paged actions in a steady-state production request stream

supersedes.reason: v2.8 correctly revealed that a Paged action is iteration-scoped and occurs once per cached request, not once per generated token; v2.9 keeps the latency and mechanism thresholds, returns to one-token requests, and preregisters sixteen measured cached requests per arm so the same real production action is repeated without mislabeling direct decode steps as K2 work

order: seeded random K1-K2 or K2-K1 order independently within each pair

request.prompt: one one one one one one one one one one one one one one one one one

controlled_boundary.steady_state_definition: erase the single slot, run one full-prompt request and four cached warm requests, then record sixteen cached one-token requests; each arm statistic is the median of those sixteen raw monotonic timings
controlled_boundary.only_intervention: an opt-in control file read by the Paged CUDA dispatcher selects incumbent K1 or candidate K2 before each arm inside one long-lived server

measurements.primary: median and P95 across thirty paired arm-level medians, each reconstructed from sixteen raw unprofiled client monotonic timings
measurements.uncertainty_gate: paired-cluster bootstrap 95% upper bounds for both median and P95 regression
measurements.mechanism_gate: PID-isolated NSYS aggregate duration across exactly 480 selected-kernel launches in each arm: twenty cached Paged actions times 24 model layers
secondary: paired server prompt median reconstructed from sixteen raw JSON responses per arm
Prometheus request-level Paged graph-entry deltas reconstructed from before/after snapshots
